properties.name: governance.exception-handling.async
properties.description: If true (the default - this module's original, only behavior), publishing an ExceptionEvent is handed off to a bounded background executor instead of the calling thread. Set false to force synchronous publishing: the event is guaranteed published before the error response is returned, at the cost of adding the publish call to response latency.

properties.name: governance.exception-handling.async-pool.core-pool-size
properties.description: Threads kept alive even when idle.

properties.name: governance.exception-handling.async-pool.max-pool-size
properties.description: Upper bound on threads under load.

properties.name: governance.exception-handling.async-pool.queue-capacity
properties.description: Bounded queue depth. When full, the CallerRunsPolicy rejection handler makes the REQUEST thread log synchronously as a fallback - deliberately never silently dropping an exception log, only trading "async" for "synchronous" under extreme, sustained load.

properties.name: governance.exception-handling.default-error-code
properties.description: Fallback error code used when a handler doesn't have a more specific one (e.g. the generic 500 handler).

properties.name: governance.exception-handling.include-stack-trace-in-response
properties.description: Whether ErrorResponse.debugDetails (the exception's stack trace) is included in the HTTP response body. Defaults to false - turn this on ONLY in a local/dev profile. Leaving it on anywhere handling real traffic hands callers internal implementation details for free.

properties.name: management.endpoint.governance-exception-handling.access
properties.description: Permitted level of access for the governanceExceptionHandling endpoint.

properties.name: management.endpoint.governance-exception-handling.cache.time-to-live
properties.description: Maximum time that a response can be cached.

properties.name: management.endpoint.governance-exception-handling.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the governanceExceptionHandling endpoint.
